title: fix(spec): the four ComponentPropsMap navigation doors list all seven NavigationModeSchema modes
body:
Part of #18459 (item N2)

> ⚠️ **Closing keyword corrected by the seat from `Fixes` to `Part of`.** Card #18459 carries FOUR items. N1 is measured DEAD on main (PR #18904 replaced the enumerating describe with a pointer at `ListViewSchema.map`, whose schema declares every key `.optional()`), and **N2 is what this PR lands**. ⛔ **N3 and N4 are NOT fixed** — both were re-measured at the live pin and deliberately left on the card, N3 with fresh numbers that supersede the card's own stale proposals. A `Fixes` would have closed the card on merge and destroyed both. The seat releases the card back to the queue on landing with a `Release:` naming what landed and what remains.

Clause-②: no

## Summary

The card carried **two shipped imprecisions**. Re-measured at the LIVE objectui pin
`87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2` before anything was changed, **one is dead and
one survives** — and the surviving one is wider than the card scoped it.

This PR fixes the surviving one. The falsification of the other is recorded below rather
than acted on.

## Zone 2 — what the re-measurement found

### N1 (lat/lng pair marked required) — FALSIFIED, already fixed. No change here.

At PR #18403 the `object-map` `map` row read:

`'Map field config, the author face: { latitudeField, longitudeField, locationField?, titleField?, descriptionField?, zoom?, center?, style? }. Taken WHOLE when present ...'`

— the enumeration the card objected to. Commit `1aa5026e30` (PR #18904, "declare `style` on
`ListMapConfigSchema` and point `object-map.map` back at it") **deleted that enumeration**.
On `main` today the row reads `'Map field config, the author face — the same block
ListViewSchema.map declares ...'`, and the generated reference renders the TYPE from
`ListMapConfigSchema` itself:

`| **map** | { latitudeField?: string; longitudeField?: string; locationField?: string; titleField?: string; … } | optional | ...`

Every key optional, no required pair claimed. The statement the card called false no longer
exists in the source or in the shipped reference.

Reproduce: `git log -S "Map field config, the author face: { latitudeField" -- packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`
returns exactly two commits, `a3d4c59d69` (added, PR #18403) and `1aa5026e30` (removed, PR #18904).

### N2 (navigation list omits `new_window`) — CONFIRMED, and it is four rows, not three.

At the live pin, `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt` and `object-tree` each hand
`schema.navigation` straight into the shared `useNavigationOverlay` hook
(`ObjectGrid.tsx:2321`, `ObjectMap.tsx:1041`, `ObjectGantt.tsx:1680`, `ObjectTree.tsx:891`).
That hook binds its own mode union to this package's `NavigationModeSchema` — its docblock
says so in as many words, *"the seven modes this hook switches on are exactly the seven the
exported union publishes"*, held by a parity test on that side — and its click router carries
a `new_window` branch that delegates to `onNavigate` and otherwise falls through to a
`window.open`. `object-gantt` implements that action itself as well.

The four `.describe()` strings listed six of the seven (no `new_window`), except `object-grid`
— the row the other three were copied from — which listed five (no `popover` either). All four
doors are `z.unknown()`, so that sentence is the entire published account of the shape, and
the reference page renders the type beside it as `any`.

### N3 (two comment citations in `component.test.ts`) — NOT fixed here, and the card's own correction is stale.

Both citations still exist (`component.test.ts:3649` `label (:1849)`, `:3750`
`ObjectGantt.tsx:501`). But they are HISTORICAL citations anchored to the retired pin
`53ded82b`, and the corrections the card proposes (`:1871`, `:500`) were measured at that
same retired pin. At the live pin the true positions are **`:503`** for the
`GanttConfigSchema.safeParse` and **`:2181`** for the label resolution — so applying the
card's numbers would replace one unverifiable pair with another. `component.test.ts` is also
outside this dispatch's declared file surface. Left for the card.

### N4 (historical pin-citation spelling) — unchanged, measured.

`check:objectui-pin-citations --list` on this head: **48 historical / 29 asserting / 7
assertion** entries. **30 historical citations still name the retired `53ded82b`**, ten of
them in `component.zod.ts`, including the three headers this card is about
(`component.zod.ts:3561` map, `:3715` gantt, `:3906` tree). The gate permits the historical
form by design, so nothing is violated and nothing reds — those anchors simply are not
re-checked on a pin bump, which is exactly what the card recorded. N3's re-measurement above
shows the drift is real and not hypothetical. Converting them is a re-measurement job, not a
spelling change, and is left for the card.

## The change

Four `.describe()` strings, plus the reference page regenerated from them with
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (never by hand):

- `ObjectGridPropsSchema.navigation`
- `ObjectMapPropsSchema.navigation`
- `ObjectGanttPropsSchema.navigation`
- `ObjectTreePropsSchema.navigation`

Each now lists `page | drawer | modal | split | popover | new_window | none` and names
`NavigationModeSchema` as the source of that list, so the next member added to the enum has a
named edge into these rows instead of four independently drifting lists.

**Why `object-grid` is in scope.** The card names it as the precedent the other three copied
and says "fixing it means fixing the family, not just these three rows". It is the same defect
class, in the same file, in the same gate family, adds no verification surface, and understates
by two rather than one. Correcting three while leaving the source of the pattern intact would
leave the family in the state that produced the defect.

No accept set moves: the doors stay `z.unknown()`.

## Changeset — measured, not pattern-matched

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`. The changed bytes ARE published bytes:

- `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` contains `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so
  `src/ui/component.zod.ts` ships verbatim in the tarball.
- The compiled strings ship in `dist/ui/index.js` and `dist/ui/index.mjs`.
- `npm pack --dry-run --json` in `packages/spec` lists all three of those paths among its
  2030 entries. `@objectstack/spec` is `private: false` at `17.4.0` — a released package.
- Controls: a positive control (an untouched describe from the same rows) is found in the same
  dist files; a negative control (a string present nowhere) is found in none.

So `skip-changeset` would have been wrong here, and no changeset would have been wrong too.

## Verification

Head `55dd769453`. `origin/main` merged in at `f2101d0492` via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`
before the final measurements; all 15 spec generated artifacts re-checked clean after it.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived
  **102 families** from the actual changed paths. All 102 run, exit codes captured to a file
  BEFORE any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`: **102 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.
- The single non-zero is `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:react-declaration-parity`
  in its bare spelling, which exits 1 by design with no `MANIFEST`. Run as CI runs it —
  `MANIFEST="$PWD/sdui.manifest.json" ... --baseline react-declaration-parity.baseline.json --strict`
  — it exits **0**, with no new declaration divergence vs the accepted baseline.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — **512 files, 14953 passed, 1 todo**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`,
  `check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, the whole repo, not narrowed) — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — all 15 artifacts up to date.
- Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; verdicts read from its
  `VERDICT command-exit` line.

## Acceptance notes

Observed while measuring, deliberately NOT changed here and not filed:

1. **These four describes account for `mode` only.** `useNavigationOverlay` also reads `size`,
   `openNewTab` and `preventNavigation`, and the TYPED sibling rows (`object-kanban`,
   `object-calendar`, the list-view entry) name all four members. On a `z.unknown()` door the
   describe is the whole account, so naming one member of four understates the block — a
   separate imprecision from the one this card carries. Carrier: the next PR touching these
   rows, or a decision to point these four doors at `NavigationConfigSchema` the way their
   typed siblings already do.
2. **A stale comment in the sibling repo.** `plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx` at the live pin
   states "measured on the installed spec: `navigation` is declared on exactly one
   `ComponentPropsMap` entry, `object-grid`". It is now declared on several. A comment in
   another repository with no contract behind it. Carrier: objectui.
3. N3 and N4 above remain open on the card, with fresh measurements recorded there.
